assertions.value: Proposed Article 265-3(1) allows collection for specified inspection/search work when necessary.
Article 265-3(2) permits requesting biometrics and limits refusal without just cause.
Article 265-3(3) requires processing under the Personal Information Protection Act.
Article 265-3(4) leaves concrete biometric scope, collection methods and procedures to the Customs Commissioner.

analysis.reason: Clarify target, necessity, transfer and retention conditions at an appropriate legal level while preserving existing privacy safeguards.

next_check.action: Re-observe latest text, deadline and committee before finalizing the opinion.

targets.title: 인공지능 활용 서비스 목록 관리 및 공표에 관한 규정안

assertions.value: Proposed Article 6(2) requires reporting specified service changes without delay.
Article 7(2) specifies annual Gazette publication by December 31, with exclusions for specified information.
The proposed Articles 6-7 do not specify an interval for public updates after change reports.
Current parent-law Article 30(2) requires annual list publication.

analysis.reason: Connect immediate reporting to timely public updates, item-level disclosure and usable responsibility/inquiry information.

next_check.action: Re-observe the rule text and opinion route before finalizing the opinion.
